en: Psalms 118

p.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 1  Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: 118:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

p.src: 2  Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 2  Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 3  Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 3  Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 4  Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 4  Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

p.src: 5  Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

en: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.
u.src: 5  Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

en:
118:5 Hebrew: יה Yah
118:5 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 6  The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

en: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
u.src: 6  The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

p.src: 7  The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

en: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
u.src: 7  The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

p.src: 8  It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.
u.src: 8  It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

p.src: 9  It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.
u.src: 9  It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

p.src: 10  All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
u.src: 10  All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

p.src: 11  They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

en: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.
u.src: 11  They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

p.src: 12  They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

en: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
u.src: 12  They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

p.src: 13  You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

en: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
u.src: 13  You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

p.src: 14  The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

en: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
u.src: 14  The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

en: 118:14 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 15  The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.
u.src: 15  The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

p.src: 16  The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”
u.src: 16  The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

p.src: 17  I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

en: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.
u.src: 17  I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

p.src: 18  The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

en: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
u.src: 18  The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

en: 118:18 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 19  Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

en: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.
u.src: 19  Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

en: 118:19 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 20  This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

en: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.
u.src: 20  This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

p.src: 21  I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

en: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
u.src: 21  I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

p.src: 22  The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

en: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
u.src: 22  The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

en: 118:22 Literally, head of the corner

p.src: 23  This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

en: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
u.src: 23  This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

p.src: 24  This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

en: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
u.src: 24  This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

p.src: 25  Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

en: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.
u.src: 25  Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

p.src: 26  Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

en: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.
u.src: 26  Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

p.src: 27  The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

en: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
u.src: 27  The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

p.src: 28  You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

en: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
u.src: 28  You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

p.src: 29  Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

en: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
u.src: 29  Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
